processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

world.

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,

help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

# Plastic Packaging Manufacturer

At Adventpac, we supply **polybags** and **films** to wholesalers and distributors.
We offer **polyethylene **and **sustainable packaging **solutions, worldwide.

[ Our Products ][36]

We Provide
* ## Quality Assurance
  
  Wtih 25+ years of experience, we have the know-how to deliver **high quality** products.
* ## Customised Packaging
  
  We manufacture fully-customised packaging solutions in terms of **size**, **colour** and
  **printing**.
* ## Worldwide Shipping
  
  Based in Malaysia, we export to over 25 clients across **15+ countries**, worldwide.

Our Product Range
* [plastic packaging manufacturer]
  
  ## Recyclable LDPE
  
  We manufacture industrial & commercial packaging using recyclable LDPE, LLDPE & HDPE.
  
  [Discover][37]
* [compostable packaging]
  
  ## Compostable Packaging
  
  Check out our compostable range; made from EN 13432 & AS 4736 certified materials.
  
  [Discover][38]
* [water soluble bag manufacturer]
  
  ## Water-Soluble Bags
  
  Single-use bags that fully dissolve in warm or hot water. Zero waste.
  
  [Discover][39]

Testimonials
* ## ★★★★★
  
  Adventpac has consistently delivered great quality packaging and has been very accomodating during
  the COVID-19 pandemic. They are experts in the industry our long serving supplier. I would highly
  recommend them to anyone in need of packaging.
  
  -*Amni Mohamed, Senior Executive Logistic and Inventory Management
  (Malaysia Airlines Berhad)*
* ## ★★★★★
  
  Advent Packaging was very easy to work with and provided excellent customer service. We switched
  to them during the COVID-19 pandemic and they were incredibly helpful. Highly recommend!
  
  -Enny Azuvilla, Procurement Officer
  (Fireflyz Sdn Bhd)
* ## ★★★★★
  
  For many years, we continue to work with Advent Packaging. They deliver a reliable service and
  product.
  Their delivery has always been prompt which is crucial to our operations and we highly recommend
  them to our business partners.
  
  -*Mohd. Sufian Abdullah, Senior Executive for Property, Facilities and SAP
  (MAS Kargo) *

[Our Sustainability Initiatives][40]
* ## Rain Harvesting
  
  We harvest over** 300,000 litres** of rain a year. That is over **65,000 toilet flushes** a year!
* ## Solar Powered
  
  Our manufacturing plant generates enough solar energy to power **220 homes** for a year!
* ## Recycling
  
  We do our own recycling in-house to **minimise waste** and **maximise output**.

## Have Questions?

Get in touch with us via the form below.
Need to pack something? We can help you.

Get in Touch

# Handles
# with care.

Alimac® is a global leader in innovative and sustainable secondary packaging solutions.

**Alimac® Group** is the global leader in the design, manufacturing and commercialization of **Carry
Handle adhesive tape solutions**. With over 35 years of expertise, Alimac® continues to redefine
packaging by expanding into sealing and complementary solutions, earning its reputation as a trusted
partner for **major automation leaders and a standout in secondary packaging**.

Trusted by over 500 partners across five continents—including top global brands in Beverage, Tissue,
Food, and Home Care—Alimac®’s solutions impact spams worldwide.

Fully in-house production through vertically integrated processes, from film extrusion to spooling,
ensures unmatched quality and continuous innovation. By investing in cutting-edge technologies and
pioneering advanced raw materials, Alimac® creates solutions that push the boundaries of what’s
possible.

Quality, service and sustainability represent Alimac® Group daily commitment.

## Alimac® solutions at a glance

## Carry handle tapes

[

### In-line / Traditional

The most flexible and versatile solutions to guarantee a perfect in-line lamination with almost
every paper carry portion material. Depending on the equipment, can be laminated also with other
materials such as PP, PE, Foam.

][45]
[

### Pre-laminated

The all-in-one solutions for the most challenging handling applications.

][46]
[

### Designed for circularity Pre-laminated

A set of certified solutions to tackle the most ambitious sustainability challenges.

][47]

## Complementary solutions

[

### Tin sealing tapes

High strength narrow width tape solutions, designed to secure perfect sealing of plastic and metal
containers by preventing surface wear and pollution.

][48]
[

### Insert accessories for in-line lamination

**Foam rolls**: Lightweight and durable, these rolls of foamed polyethylene (PE) are designed for
applying handles to packages. They provide protection for heavy or fragile items and ensure a
comfortable grip. Customization is available to meet specific requirements.

**Paper rolls**: Paper rolls are also used in the handle application process. This represents a
standard solution for general-purpose, mid-range handle application equipment. A wide array of
customization options is offered.

][49]
[

### Multipack

As part of the Alimac® Group commitment in “handling with care” the future of packaging by
continuously differentiating and enhancing a comprehensive portfolio of secondary packaging
solutions as an integrated end of line solutions provider.

][50]

**Our approach to circularity** helps customers elevate their packaging, distinguishing it from the
competition while simplifying the purchasing journey for end consumers. This is achieved through
innovative, fully integrated and customized packaging solutions.

# Handles
# with care.

Alimac® is a global leader in innovative and sustainable secondary packaging solutions.

**Alimac® Group** is the global leader in the design, manufacturing and commercialization of **Carry
Handle adhesive tape solutions**. With over 35 years of expertise, Alimac® continues to redefine
packaging by expanding into sealing and complementary solutions, earning its reputation as a trusted
partner for **major automation leaders and a standout in secondary packaging**.

Trusted by over 500 partners across five continents—including top global brands in Beverage, Tissue,
Food, and Home Care—Alimac®’s solutions impact spams worldwide.

Fully in-house production through vertically integrated processes, from film extrusion to spooling,
ensures unmatched quality and continuous innovation. By investing in cutting-edge technologies and
pioneering advanced raw materials, Alimac® creates solutions that push the boundaries of what’s
possible.

Quality, service and sustainability represent Alimac® Group daily commitment.

## Alimac® solutions at a glance

## Carry handle tapes

[

### In-line / Traditional

The most flexible and versatile solutions to guarantee a perfect in-line lamination with almost
every paper carry portion material. Depending on the equipment, can be laminated also with other
materials such as PP, PE, Foam.

][45]
[

### Pre-laminated

The all-in-one solutions for the most challenging handling applications.

][46]
[

### Designed for circularity Pre-laminated

A set of certified solutions to tackle the most ambitious sustainability challenges.

][47]

## Complementary solutions

[

### Tin sealing tapes

High strength narrow width tape solutions, designed to secure perfect sealing of plastic and metal
containers by preventing surface wear and pollution.

][48]
[

### Insert accessories for in-line lamination

**Foam rolls**: Lightweight and durable, these rolls of foamed polyethylene (PE) are designed for
applying handles to packages. They provide protection for heavy or fragile items and ensure a
comfortable grip. Customization is available to meet specific requirements.

**Paper rolls**: Paper rolls are also used in the handle application process. This represents a
standard solution for general-purpose, mid-range handle application equipment. A wide array of
customization options is offered.

][49]
[

### Multipack

As part of the Alimac® Group commitment in “handling with care” the future of packaging by
continuously differentiating and enhancing a comprehensive portfolio of secondary packaging
solutions as an integrated end of line solutions provider.

][50]

**Our approach to circularity** helps customers elevate their packaging, distinguishing it from the
competition while simplifying the purchasing journey for end consumers. This is achieved through
innovative, fully integrated and customized packaging solutions.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# The Gate of Fresh Produce


Connecting East Kenyan farmers to global markets with premium avocados and mangoes, grown and packed
with care, quality, and sustainability

[Contact us][18]

## **We create the perfect solution to all your horticultural needs in providing sustainably grown
## fruits, packed and exported directly to your market.**

### **Why Choose Avogate?**
* **Premium Quality:** Fresh produce that meets the highest global standards.
* **Sustainability First:** Eco-friendly operations that protect our planet.
* **Farmer Empowerment:** Creating lasting impact in rural communities.
* **Trusted Gateway:** Certified, transparent, and export-ready.

# **Our Reach**

Serving supermarkets, wholesalers, and retail chains across Gulf States, Turkey, European Union, and
China


   

# **The Gate of Fresh Produce**

## Frequently asked questions

What products does Avogate offer?

**Fruits:** Avocadoes, Mangoes and Purple passion fruits

**Vegetables:** Green Beans, Snow peas(Mangetout), Garden Peas and Sugar Snaps

**Herbs and Spices: **Red Demon Chilli, Thyme, Basil, Terragon

How can I contact customer support for Service inquiries?

You can reach our customer support team by emailing support@avogate.co.ke, calling +254707380676, or
using the live chat on our website. Our dedicated team is available 24/7 to assist with any
inquiries or issues.

We’re committed to providing timely and efficient packing services to ensure your satisfaction.

### 5000+ Avocado farmers trust our  Avogate to elevate their business through sound agronomical and
### technical advice at production, packing and export of fresh produce. 



### Join us in revolutionizing the avocado industry.

##### What you will get with our avocado pack house?

* Premium quality & fast turnaround

* Advanced washing & cold chain systems

* Custom eco-friendly packaging

* Sorting, grading & traceability

* Certified export compliance

* Sustainable, efficient logistics

How can we help?

#### Contact us anytime

What's in every report

## Investor-grade diligence. Not a vibe check.

Every report runs 30 sections across two deep analyses — so you walk into any investor meeting with
evidence, not hope.

Validation Report 30 sections
01Problem statement

A crisp articulation of the core problem your idea sets out to solve, framed the way a customer
would feel it.

02Problem validation

Evidence on whether the problem is real, frequent and painful enough that people will actually pay
to solve it.

03Ideal customer profiles (ICPs)

The specific segments, triggers and buying motions worth targeting first — and the ones to
deprioritise.

04Market sizing (TAM, SAM, SOM)

Defensible top-down and bottom-up estimates so you know whether this is a feature, a company, or a
category.

05Market opportunity

Where demand, timing and tailwinds line up in your favour — and how big the opening really is.

06Cartesian competitive positioning map

A two-axis map showing exactly where you'd sit against rivals, and which quadrant is still open.

07SWOT analysis

Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats assessed honestly — no cheerleading.

08Unique selling proposition (USP) analysis

What makes you genuinely different — and whether that edge is defensible over time.

09Pricing strategy

Models, tiers and price points that fit your market, your margins and your customers' willingness to
pay.

10Validation plan

A concrete, step-by-step plan to test the riskiest assumptions cheaply before you commit real
resources.

11Expected growth rate (CAGR) & revenue timeline

Realistic growth and revenue projections mapped over time, with the assumptions behind them.

12Recommendations

Clear, prioritised guidance on what to do next — and what to leave alone for now.

13Challenging questions

The hard questions a sharp investor or skeptic will ask — so you have answers ready.

14Additional insights

Notable findings that don't fit neatly elsewhere but materially shape the decision.

15System flow

How the product, users and value move through the system, from first touch to retention.

16Project Analysis sources

The references, datasets and citations that underpin the project analysis above.

17Competitors list

A curated roster of the players you'll be up against, direct and indirect.

18Customer profiles (ICPs)

Who each competitor actually serves today, and where their attention is focused.

19Unique selling propositions (USPs)

How rivals position and differentiate themselves — and the claims they lean on.

20Features matrix

A side-by-side comparison of what each competitor offers, and where the gaps are.

21Pricing matrix

How competitors package and price, mapped together so the white space is obvious.

22Strengths and weaknesses

Where each competitor is strong, and where they're exposed enough for you to attack.

23Market share

Who owns what slice of the market today, and how concentrated the field is.

24Market value

The size and value of the space these competitors play in, in hard numbers.

25Target region

The geographies each competitor focuses on, and which markets are still under-served.

26Growth rate (CAGR)

How fast each competitor — and the market as a whole — is actually growing.

27Additional insights

Extra competitive intelligence worth knowing before you pick your angle.

28Competitor landscape diagram

A visual map of the competitive field that shows clusters, leaders and open lanes at a glance.

29Actionable takeaways for a fundraising founder

The concrete moves to make given everything the landscape reveals.

30Competitor Analysis sources

The references, datasets and citations that underpin the competitor analysis.

search.

gains.

Circular’s platform finds cost savings and efficiency gains for buyers and suppliers.
[

### For Buyers

Create faster, smarter, more efficient solutions from market data to supplier matching to
transactions.

Blue chip brands found savings of 20% on materials.

][34][

### For Suppliers

Match with active buyers, drive sales, access detailed market data, create and manage your company
profile.

Suppliers found 3 new global opportunities in their first quarter.

][35]
We help global brands and manufacturers find the materials they need to power growth.

## How It Works

#### Collate Fragmented Market Data

We gather market data on opaque and fragmented markets in collaboration with our global supply
partners.

#### Commoditize Data with AI

Circular AI ingests, digitizes, and indexes market data in a format that is easy to navigate and
search.

#### Develop Modern Sourcing Solutions

With data, buyers and suppliers increase sourcing event success through cost savings and efficiency
gains.

Customer Success Story

## “

## Circular helps large brands cut through opaque, fragmented PCR markets to make sourcing quality
## materials much easier. Oh, and there’s clear time and cost benefits, too. I wish we’d had this
## tool years ago!”

Adam Lowry

## SUSTAINABLE PACKAGING FOR A BETTER FUTURE

### What Is PCR Bag?

PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) bags are sustainable packaging, crafted from Post- Consumer recycle
plastics, reducing new plastic demand, conserving resources, and lowering environmental impact. They
offer durability like conventional bags while promoting a circular economy, aligning with
eco-conscious choices for businesses and consumers committed to sustainability.

### What Is a Compostable?

Compostable bags are an eco-friendly sustainable alternative to traditional plastic bags. These bags
are made from biodegradable materials like cornstarch or PLA (polylactic acid), which break down
naturally when exposed to the right conditions. Compostable bags are designed to decompose into
organic matter within a composting environment, leaving no harmful residues behind.

## SUSTAINABLE PACKAGING FOR A BETTER FUTURE

### What Is PCR Bag?

PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) bags are sustainable packaging, crafted from Post- Consumer recycle
plastics, reducing new plastic demand, conserving resources, and lowering environmental impact. They
offer durability like conventional bags while promoting a circular economy, aligning with
eco-conscious choices for businesses and consumers committed to sustainability.

### What Is a Compostable?

Compostable bags are an eco-friendly sustainable alternative to traditional plastic bags. These bags
are made from biodegradable materials like cornstarch or PLA (polylactic acid), which break down
naturally when exposed to the right conditions. Compostable bags are designed to decompose into
organic matter within a composting environment, leaving no harmful residues behind.

About KEPRO

## Kenya's Path to a Clean Natural Environment

**Kenya Extended Producer Responsibility Organization (KEPRO)** is the leading Producer
Responsibility Organization bringing together key stakeholders to properly manage non-hazardous
post-consumer packaging waste in Kenya.

Our purpose is to accelerate the growth of Kenya's **Recycling Ecosystem**, leading to a Circular
Economy that will protect our natural environment and create jobs for future generations.

This will be achieved through the implementation of a proven **Extended Producer Responsibility
model** embedded within the environmental laws and legal framework of Kenya.

## Frequently asked questions

### Am I eligible for a subscription?

If you’re over 18, a Singapore Citizen, Permanent Resident, EP or S Pass holder then you’re eligible
to apply.

### How quickly will I get my device once my subscription is approved?

Delivery time frames vary by device and your selections. You’ll see an estimated delivery time frame
at check out. Once your order is approved, you’ll get detailed info in your approval email.

### What are my options at the end of my subscription term?

Upgrade to a new model or swap to a refurbished device, renew your existing device, or return.
Either way you're helping power the Circular economy.

### How does Circular ensure my privacy?

Our IT experts will erase any forgotten data upon return of your devices. Guaranteed.

### I have more questions. Where can I seek help?

You can check out our detailed [FAQs][24] or drop us an [email][25] or contact us via the chat bot.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

comes to integration.

## Single Source Turnkey Packaging Systems

The concept of turnkey packaging lines can have multiple interpretations for both buyers and
sellers. It is crucial to consider the context when using this term. For instance, large
conglomerates often employ the term to describe a range of packaging machines that may be designed,
engineered, manufactured, and shipped by different facilities or what was once different companies.

This often involves additional costs for engineering services and can even pose challenges when it
comes to integration.

There's another simpler definition -

**One team for all machines: design, engineering, manufacturing, acceptance testing, commissioning,
training and support by people who share the same cafeteria. **An entire line assembled, debugged
and accepted in the manufacturing facility can dramatically improve project outcomes. That's real
single source.

[[Why Single Source is Important]][114]

## Handbook For Efficient And Consistent V/F/F/S Operations

It's a critically important topic across manufacturing industries - and it's one that we're
committed to fostering dialog around.

As an organization, we stand behind our "no end of life" principle.

We also reject the industry mindset that over the decades of running your packaging machines that
it's expected that you'll see incremental loss in efficiency as they age. 

This is unacceptable to us and if you're experiencing any drop in efficiency, know that for our
customers, we're committed to restoring it.

Download this guide based on our methodical efficiency audit process.

Frequent asked questions:
What is Searchfunder.com?
Searchfunder.com is an online community of searchers, investors, lenders, brokers and other
professionals. Over 80% of those involved in searchfunds maintain a Searchfunder account to help
them network, hire, and mentor others.
What are the benefits of membership?
In addition to accessing the most active online network of business buyers, Searchfunder licenses
research that is simply not cost effective for individuals. Access over 15,000 industry reports and
50,000 transaction financials. You also get monthly credits for contact information for your company
sourcing campaign with the option to purchase more at drastically discounted rates. Searchfunder has
pre-purchased access from these data providers in order to empower individual buyers and to help
searchers level the playing field versus private equity.
Do you have deals?
While we are primarily a buy-side network, we do have hundreds of brokers that regularly post deals
to the community.
Can I find an internship on Searchfunder?
Absolutely! We have the industry's largest intern job board. If you are considering a search, the
first step is to help another business buyer so you can hit the ground running.
What does it cost?
Searchfunder is a subscription service. We offer flexible monthly, annual and lifetime memberships.
Monthly
$79 / month
Annual
$19 / month
Lifetime
$432 / once
Those who maintain an account with us for over 4 continuous years are permanently added to the
community without the need for a membership.
Do I need an MBA to join?
While a large number of our members come from dedicated programs at Harvard Business School,
Stanford GSB, Chicago Booth, and other top programs, searching is no longer reserved for the elite.
With the current abundance of dry powder in private equity, and an increasing number of business
owners reaching retirement age, good deals rarely go unfunded.

professionals. Over 80% of those involved in searchfunds maintain a Searchfunder account to help
them network, hire, and mentor others.
What are the benefits of membership?
In addition to accessing the most active online network of business buyers, Searchfunder licenses
research that is simply not cost effective for individuals. Access over 15,000 industry reports and
50,000 transaction financials. You also get monthly credits for contact information for your company
sourcing campaign with the option to purchase more at drastically discounted rates. Searchfunder has
pre-purchased access from these data providers in order to empower individual buyers and to help
searchers level the playing field versus private equity.
Do you have deals?
While we are primarily a buy-side network, we do have hundreds of brokers that regularly post deals
to the community.
Can I find an internship on Searchfunder?
Absolutely! We have the industry's largest intern job board. If you are considering a search, the
first step is to help another business buyer so you can hit the ground running.
What does it cost?
Searchfunder is a subscription service. We offer flexible monthly, annual and lifetime memberships.
Monthly
$79 / month
Annual
$19 / month
Lifetime
$432 / once
Those who maintain an account with us for over 4 continuous years are permanently added to the
community without the need for a membership.
Do I need an MBA to join?
While a large number of our members come from dedicated programs at Harvard Business School,
Stanford GSB, Chicago Booth, and other top programs, searching is no longer reserved for the elite.
With the current abundance of dry powder in private equity, and an increasing number of business
owners reaching retirement age, good deals rarely go unfunded.

# Recycled Plastic Supplier in Europe

[SERVICES][2][ABOUT US][3][CONTACT US][4]

## Our Recycled Plastics & Services

### Supply Chain Management

We manage the full supply chain for recycled plastic raw materials — from sourcing post-industrial
scrap to final delivery. Our logistics network spans Europe, connecting processors, traders, and
manufacturers with speed and reliability. Every shipment is tracked end-to-end, with full
documentation and traceability to meet buyer and compliance requirements. Whether you need a one-off
bulk order or a recurring supply agreement, we structure the process around your timeline and volume
needs.

### Recycled LDPE

We supply recycled LDPE in granule and regrind form for bulk orders across Europe. Sourced from
post-industrial waste streams, our material is suitable for film production, packaging, and
industrial applications. Available in multiple grades including LDPE 98/02.

### Recycled HDPE

Our recycled HDPE is sourced from post-industrial waste and processed to consistent specifications.
Available as regrind and flakes in bulk, widely used in pipe manufacturing, containers, and
construction. Reliable quality, competitive wholesale pricing.

### Recycled PP

We source and distribute recycled PP in granule and regrind form for bulk buyers across Europe. Used
in automotive components, packaging, and textiles, recycled polypropylene is one of the
highest-demand materials in the secondary plastics market. Consistent grades, bulk availability.

### Plastic Scrap

We buy and trade post-industrial plastic scrap — LDPE film, HDPE regrind, PP waste, and mixed
streams — directly from manufacturers and processors. If you generate plastic scrap and need a
reliable buyer, or you are looking to source scrap material in bulk, we connect you with verified
partners across Europe quickly and transparently.

### Market Access

Our network of verified recycled plastic suppliers and buyers spans Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
We give manufacturers direct access to reliable polymer sources — cutting out middlemen, reducing
costs, and enabling efficient cross-border trade. From first inquiry to delivery, we handle
sourcing, negotiation, and logistics so you can focus on production.

## Recycled Plastic Distribution from Düsseldorf

Based in Düsseldorf, Germany, we are a recycled plastic raw material supplier connecting
post-industrial waste streams with manufacturers across Europe — built on speed, reliability, and
sustainable sourcing.

post-industrial plastic scrap to distributors and manufacturers across Europe and beyond.

We are building one of Europe's most reliable recycled plastic distribution networks — with

# Recycled Plastic Supplier in Europe

[SERVICES][2][ABOUT US][3][CONTACT US][4]

## Our Recycled Plastics & Services

### Supply Chain Management

We manage the full supply chain for recycled plastic raw materials — from sourcing post-industrial
scrap to final delivery. Our logistics network spans Europe, connecting processors, traders, and
manufacturers with speed and reliability. Every shipment is tracked end-to-end, with full
documentation and traceability to meet buyer and compliance requirements. Whether you need a one-off
bulk order or a recurring supply agreement, we structure the process around your timeline and volume
needs.

### Recycled LDPE

We supply recycled LDPE in granule and regrind form for bulk orders across Europe. Sourced from
post-industrial waste streams, our material is suitable for film production, packaging, and
industrial applications. Available in multiple grades including LDPE 98/02.

### Recycled HDPE

Our recycled HDPE is sourced from post-industrial waste and processed to consistent specifications.
Available as regrind and flakes in bulk, widely used in pipe manufacturing, containers, and
construction. Reliable quality, competitive wholesale pricing.

### Recycled PP

We source and distribute recycled PP in granule and regrind form for bulk buyers across Europe. Used
in automotive components, packaging, and textiles, recycled polypropylene is one of the
highest-demand materials in the secondary plastics market. Consistent grades, bulk availability.

### Plastic Scrap

We buy and trade post-industrial plastic scrap — LDPE film, HDPE regrind, PP waste, and mixed
streams — directly from manufacturers and processors. If you generate plastic scrap and need a
reliable buyer, or you are looking to source scrap material in bulk, we connect you with verified
partners across Europe quickly and transparently.

### Market Access

Our network of verified recycled plastic suppliers and buyers spans Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
We give manufacturers direct access to reliable polymer sources — cutting out middlemen, reducing
costs, and enabling efficient cross-border trade. From first inquiry to delivery, we handle
sourcing, negotiation, and logistics so you can focus on production.

# Policy shifts and market pressures are reshaping packaging decisions.

### The U.S. Plastics Pact (USPP) brings together companies and organizations across the entire
### plastic packaging system to develop and implement practical, scalable solutions for a changing
### regulatory, market, and operational landscape.

[**Explore Our Work**][24]

## Why collaboration
## matters now

No single organization can solve today’s packaging challenges alone. As policies evolve, markets
shift, and expectations grow, companies need practical ways to navigate complexity and make
progress. Circularity only works if it works across the entire packaging system. Solutions must be
technically feasible, economically viable, and scalable across the value chain.

The U.S. Plastics Pact brings the right stakeholders together to develop tools, guidance, and
initiatives that organizations can apply in their own work.

## Our Mission & Vision

**MISSION: **The U.S. Plastics Pact brings together the full plastic packaging value chain in a
collaborative forum to drive measurable, system-wide progress by advancing solutions and informing
policies that keep materials in use, reduce waste, and deliver environmental, social, and economic
benefits.

**VISION:**** **A world where plastic packaging stays in use, out of nature, and contributes to a
thriving economy, healthy communities, and a cleaner environment.

Roadmap 2.0: A shared framework for circularity

Roadmap 2.0 reflects the next phase of the U.S. Plastics Pact’s work—building on the foundation
established through the Roadmap to 2025 and shifting toward deeper, action-oriented impact.
Developed in collaboration with our signatories (or “Activators”), Roadmap 2.0 reflects a more
mature understanding of system complexity. It aligns stakeholders around priority actions and
focuses collaboration where it can drive the greatest progress.

Roadmap 2.0 focuses on five interconnected Targets that provide a shared direction for advancing
circular packaging. Activators support the advancement of these Targets, with each organization
determining how—and to what extent—they work toward them based on their own strategies and
priorities:

1

Eliminate problematic and unnecessary plastic packaging

Guidance and resources
to support elimination, redesign, and improved material choices

2

Design
all plastic
packaging
for circularity

Guidance and collaboration to advance reusable, recyclable, or compostable packaging design

3

Improve
recycling and composting outcomes

effective recycling or composting
of plastic packaging

4

of recycled

recycled or responsibly

5

reuse
systems

Guidance and collaboration to pilot, expand, and scale reuse models or Informs USPP initiatives,
guidance, and resources to advance reuse at scale

Together, these Targets help guide collaborative efforts to reduce plastic waste
and build a more circular plastic packaging system.

[**Read the Roadmap**][25]

## Solutions-focused engagement across the packaging system

The U.S. Plastics Pact is a voluntary, participant-driven initiative. Our role is to convene,
facilitate, and support collaboration across the packaging system.

Through structured engagement, participants identify shared challenges, test ideas, and develop
practical approaches that reflect real-world complexity.

This work is shaped through cross-sector workstreams focused on priority issues, regular Activator
engagement and feedback, technical workshops designed to address shared challenges, and strategic
input from advisory and sector-specific groups.

## Resources & initiatives that support action

The U.S. Plastics Pact develops practical resources to help organizations navigate the transition to
circular packaging.
